title: Duke and the Tube
lines: Ben has a cute mule. His name is Duke.
They take the long path home from the lake.
Then Duke stops and sits in the dust.
"Up, Duke!" said Ben. The mule just sits.
Ben tugs. Duke will not get up.
Ben holds up a bun. Duke naps.
Then Ben gets a long tube from his bag.
He hums a tune in the tube.
Duke lifts his nose. He jumps up fast!
Duke walks home, and Ben hums the whole time.

questions.ask: What does Ben try first to get Duke up?
questions.listenFor: He tugs, then he holds up a bun. Duke naps. Send them back to those two lines.

questions.ask: What finally gets Duke up on his feet?
questions.listenFor: The tune Ben hums in the tube. If they say "the tube," ask what Ben did with it.

questions.ask: What do you think Ben will take next time? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. Listen for something like "the tube, because that tune got Duke moving."
